title: Ruby 4.0 Universal RCE Deserialization Gadget Chain
summary: A detailed security research article documenting the discovery of a universal Remote Code Execution (RCE) deserialization gadget chain affecting Ruby 4.0 applications, enabling attackers to achieve code execution through unsafe deserialization vulnerabilities.
problem_solved: Exposes critical deserialization vulnerabilities in Ruby 4.0 that allow attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution through carefully crafted object chains.
why_valuable: Provides essential security research for the Ruby community to understand and defend against deserialization attacks before they can be exploited in production systems.
